title: CASE Expression in SQL
definition: CASE expression is used to apply conditional logic in SQL queries, similar to if-else statements in programming.

queries.description: Categorize salary as HIGH or LOW
queries.query: SELECT full_name, salary, CASE WHEN salary >= 50000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS salary_category FROM employee;

queries.description: Categorize salary as HIGH, MID, or LOW
queries.query: SELECT full_name, salary, CASE WHEN salary >= 60000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN salary >= 45000 THEN 'MID' ELSE 'LOW' END AS salary_category FROM employee;
SELECT full_name, salary, CASE WHEN salary >= 50000 THEN salary * 0.10 ELSE salary * 0.05 END AS bonus FROM employee;
